scope: Full official panel and one separate-process replay; receipt and independent aggregate arithmetic review.
limitations: Three seed clusters support only descriptive exploration, not statistical significance or promotion.
Independent replay repeats the same official engine and shared validator, not a separate rules implementation.
Live and primary model counts share a reconstruction source; they are not independent live monitoring.
Raw worker receipts, replays, model weights and per-step private states remain local.
Membership and memory limits are sampled, not hard real-time bounds; historical seed exclusion is incomplete.
Prior and later hashes cannot exclude transient replacement followed by restoration.
